scope: Instrumented native source diagnostics. Frame-start cadence is not physical presentation rate, GPU time or input latency. No 60 FPS acceptance, general speedup or portable qualification is inferred.
verdict: No overall mean frame-time improvement is established. Final run is diagnostic because focus changed and initial free RAM differed. Exact paid rendering is independently verified; source caches remove repeated work but their causal timing benefit is not isolated.

method.statistics: Nearest-rank quantiles. Comparison values are unrounded extraction of receipt aggregates, serialized to at most six decimals for readability.
method.visible_paid_ground: Recomputed from raw Court elapsed samples indexed by each per-draw region record; duplicate/out-of-range indices are rejected, and full coverage is recorded. Means do not include empty post-effect draws.
method.frame_activity: Prior frame post-process world state labels the following process-start interval; world paid-ground presence is not the same as visible Court coverage.
method.timers: Elapsed CPU-side observations include scheduling/driver waits. Nested region/surface timers are inclusive and not additive; last-fixed-step stages sample only the last completed step per process frame.
method.missing_values: Null means not recorded or not available, never zero. Baseline Mantle admission/refusal counts were not recorded.
method.raw_storage: Full per-frame metrics remain local under .godot; SHA256 and byte lengths below identify the exact files.

comparability_limits: Baseline wrapper failed: requested 1280x720, actual 1290x730. All runs actually used 1290x730; this does not retrospectively pass baseline validation.
Baseline observer source differs from both candidates. Candidates use the same profile script SHA256; added preparation/active-region observation can affect timing versus baseline.
Final wrapper reports measured and validates viewport/source/completion/stderr, but does not reject focus loss. Exact per-case focus counts are preserved below.
Final run began with 632.62 MiB available OS RAM versus 1295.06 MiB baseline and 1585.01 MiB intermediate. Paging/thermal/background load was not controlled or attributed.

Final paid Hearth cases required 12 terrain chunks versus 15 in the intermediate run. Focus-sensitive camera state can change visible work, so small Court changes cannot be assigned to the edge-mask patch.
These are sequential single observations, not randomized repeats or an isolated source ablation. Ten-second tails are short samples.
The 60-second soak belongs only to p60-3a7e6f5fee64, before final edge-mask/save changes. It is not a final-source endurance receipt.

intermediate_soak.interpretation: Texture bytes and terrain residency/requests/uploads stayed unchanged. Static memory rose 16,424,066 bytes while the diagnostic retained growing raw sample arrays; this neither establishes a production leak nor proves stable production RAM.

structural_evidence.edge_mask_contract: At most 8 topologies x 512 masks. Reuse requires identity of the immutable count witness, a freshly computed live seam prefix and exact ordered fixed geometry. External maps/mutations fall back. Draw commands, geometry, order, widths, colors and authority are unchanged.
structural_evidence.streaming_contract: 2 MiB admission/upload byte budget and a 2 ms between-operations target; indivisible validation/upload may exceed the target, then further admissions stop. This is not a hard per-frame time cap.

remaining_hotspot: Paid Court remains the largest measured individual draw layer. Final Mantle Court mean 5.166848 ms consists of geometry 0.108190, bundle 1.845938 and drawing/other 3.212721 ms; this scene was unfocused. Final close Fire visible-paid Court mean is 8.077180 ms versus 4.126629 ms for all draws including post-effect idle.
next_bounded_direction: First obtain focused, same-camera, controlled full/light repeated samples before attributing regression. Then trial retaining one unchanged campus or HUD CanvasItem command layer separately from live paid Court; preserve exact geometry/order and bounded residency, verify RGBA, and retain only if repeated same-scene CPU/frame costs improve. Current layout caches do not eliminate native draw submission.

next_direction_engine_reference.title: Godot 4.6 custom drawing in 2D — Updating
next_direction_engine_reference.basis: CanvasItem _draw commands are retained until queue_redraw requests another draw. Applying this mechanism to a separate campus or HUD layer remains a proposed experiment, with benefit on the game's Godot 4.7.1 build unmeasured.
